problem: Why can every worker say done while the user task fails?
principle: Compare whole tasks under matched model/tool/evidence/budget conditions. Measure artifacts, handoffs, effects and cost; trace bottlenecks and gate violations independently.
solutions: Not a substitute for offline quality
check: Does better worker accuracy establish better system quality?
answer: No. Handoffs, evidence merge, budgets, latency and business acceptance also matter.
diagram_title: Validate collaboration benefit and operational quality
scope: Design reference and local contracts; no model training or measured collaboration uplift.
